BL-832 — Bubble Health page — traverse time, rework, bottleneck stage and velocity over a recent window, as a remote HTML page reading the computations the bridge already performs
What it solves: ## e2e procedure for QA
Approval context: The judgement worth the human's eye is the window, because it is the one place this ticket does not give them what they asked for as they asked for it. They said "about two weeks"; the page instead labels each readout with the window its own computation genuinely uses, because the alternative — for…
BL-832 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-832" (or "reject BL-832 <reason>") to act.
